title: Food Temperature Training Sign-Off Form
subtitle: A practical observed-practice training sign-off for food temperature that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations observed-practice training sign-off for food temperature covering temperature reading and product disposition, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a food operations lead opens one food temperature record to plan instruction, observe practice, identify knowledge and authority limits, assign follow-up, and acknowledge the resulting work scope; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Temperature training sign-off identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this training sign-off to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Temperature event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Food Temperature scope and routing context

sections.title: Temperature training plan and learner route
sections.guidance: Define the procedure revision, learning method, practice setting, supervisor, and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Temperature competencies
items: Identifies the food, equipment, and sample point
Selects and checks the authorized instrument
Finds the current policy target without guessing
Records time, value, and measurement unit
Performs confirmation readings when directed
Recognizes unknown exposure and equipment exceptions
Protects product while awaiting a decision
Stays within disposition authority
Routes illness and food-safety judgments
Completes follow-up reading and handoff

blocks.label: Training and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records measurements and decisions under the current procedure; it does not set temperature limits or certify food safety or regulatory compliance. Do not guess a target, exposure duration, or disposition. Stop affected activity when policy requires and route illness, safety, and final product decisions to the qualified food-safety reviewer under applicable requirements. This sign-off records observed practice and assigned limits; it is not a license, professional certification, or guarantee of future performance.

sections.title: Temperature coached practice and evidence
sections.guidance: Record the scenario, learner action, observable result, coaching, and next attempt rather than a generic pass mark.

blocks.label: Exception scenarios reviewed
items: Applicable target or policy source unavailable
Instrument result cannot be relied upon
Reading exceeds local action point
Exposure history is incomplete
Product or equipment disposition is disputed
Qualified food-safety review is required

blocks.label: Strengths, repeated errors, prompts required, evidence references, and conditions for another observation

sections.title: Temperature knowledge check, limits, and escalation
sections.guidance: Confirm that the learner can identify sources, stop conditions, authorization limits, escalation owners, and handoff evidence.

blocks.label: Condition and exception knowledge
items: Instrument unavailable, damaged, or readiness check fails
Food, batch, case, or sample point unclear
Reading is outside the current policy target
Repeat reading materially differs
Exposure start or duration is unknown
Equipment alarm, door, power, airflow, or seal concern
Product has already moved, sold, or been served
Disposition authority or follow-up owner unavailable

blocks.label: Knowledge gaps, restricted tasks, retraining topics, interim supervision, and evidence needed

fields.label: Food Temperature knowledge gaps and limits

sections.title: Temperature work authorization and follow-up plan
sections.guidance: Grant only the observed scope and state the supervision, expiry, reassessment, or restriction that applies.

blocks.label: Training authorization handoff
items: Readiness decision communicated to scheduler
Restricted tasks visible to supervising owner
Procedure version and practice evidence linked
Coach accepted follow-up responsibility
Reassessment date or trigger recorded
Learner can identify the escalation route

sections.title: Temperature outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Temperature closeout controls
items: Final reading, time, unit, and instrument retained
Policy target and variance decision recorded
Affected product quantity and status handed off
Equipment or facilities ticket linked
Follow-up reading owner and due time assigned
Qualified review and final disposition recorded

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Food Temperature residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Training Sign-Off closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
